knowledge:
- key_parameters: features=A character vector of gene/feature IDs to plot ;; group=The metadata column name (in colData or Seurat object metadata) defining cell groupings ;; groupAnno=The metadata column name used to annotate the cell grouping columns ;; featureAnno=The row metadata column name used to annotate the features/genes ;; scale=Logical value; when TRUE, plots Z-scores instead of logcounts, which typically improves row clustering ;; groupLegends=Logical value; whether to display legends for the groups ;; annoColors=A named list of color vectors specifying custom palettes for the annotations ;; annoWidth=Numeric value specifying the width of the annotation bars
- alternatives: scater::plotDots() (for unclustered/unannotated SingleCellExperiment dot plots) ;; Seurat::DotPlot() (for unclustered/unannotated Seurat dot plots) ;; aplot (for manual assembly of complex heatmaps/dot plots with dendrograms)
- when_to_use: Use this package when you want to visualize marker gene expression across cell clusters or cell types while simultaneously performing hierarchical clustering on both cells and genes, and adding visual annotation bars to the rows and/or columns.
- pitfalls: Clustering raw logcounts can sometimes yield suboptimal row clustering; setting scale = TRUE to plot Z-scores is highly recommended to improve clustering results. Feature annotations (featureAnno) require the corresponding metadata to be present in the rowData (for SingleCellExperiment) or the assay's feature metadata (for Seurat).

workflows.name: single_cell_experiment_dotplot
workflows.intent: Generate an annotated, hierarchically clustered dot plot from a SingleCellExperiment object.
input: sce (SingleCellExperiment object containing log-normalized counts, cell-type annotations in colData, and marker annotations in rowData)
workflows.stages: 1. Normalize and subset the SingleCellExperiment object ;; 2. Identify marker genes and add them to the rowData of the object ;; 3. Generate the clustered dot plot with annotations using scDotPlot
workflows.code:
sce <- sce |> 
    logNormCounts() |>  
    subset(x = _, , level2class != "(none)")

features <- sce |>
    scoreMarkers(sce$level1class) |>
    map(~ .x |>
            as.data.frame() |>
            arrange(desc(mean.AUC))|>
            dplyr::slice(1:6) |>
            rownames()) |> 
    unlist2()

rowData(sce)$Marker <- features[match(rownames(sce), features)] |>
    names()

sce |>
    scDotPlot(features = features,
              group = "level2class",
              groupAnno = "level1class",
              featureAnno = "Marker",
              groupLegends = FALSE,
              annoColors = list("level1class" = pal_d3()(7),
                                "Marker" = pal_d3()(7)),
              annoWidth = 0.02)

sce |>
    scDotPlot(scale = TRUE,
              features = features,
              group = "level2class",
              groupAnno = "level1class",
              featureAnno = "Marker",
              groupLegends = FALSE,
              annoColors = list("level1class" = pal_d3()(7),
                                "Marker" = pal_d3()(7)),
              annoWidth = 0.02)

workflows.name: seurat_dotplot
workflows.intent: Generate an annotated, hierarchically clustered dot plot from a Seurat object.
input: pbmc_small (Seurat object containing expression data, cluster metadata, and marker annotations in the assay metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify marker genes for each cluster ;; 2. Add marker annotations to the Seurat assay metadata ;; 3. Generate the clustered dot plot with annotations using scDotPlot
workflows.code:
features <- pbmc_small |>
    FindAllMarkers(only.pos = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    dplyr::slice(1:6) |>
    dplyr::select(cluster, gene)

pbmc_small[[DefaultAssay(pbmc_small)]][[]] <- pbmc_small[[DefaultAssay(pbmc_small)]][[]] |>
    rownames_to_column("gene") |> 
    left_join(features, by = "gene") |> 
    column_to_rownames("gene")

features <- features |> 
    deframe()

pbmc_small |>
    scDotPlot(features = features,
              group = "RNA_snn_res.1",
              groupAnno = "RNA_snn_res.1",
              featureAnno = "cluster",
              annoColors = list("RNA_snn_res.1" = pal_d3()(7),
                                "cluster" = pal_d3()(7)),
              groupLegends = FALSE,
              annoWidth = 0.075)

pbmc_small |>
    scDotPlot(scale = TRUE,
              features = features,
              group = "RNA_snn_res.1",
              groupAnno = "RNA_snn_res.1",
              featureAnno = "cluster",
              annoColors = list("RNA_snn_res.1" = pal_d3()(7),
                                "cluster" = pal_d3()(7)),
              groupLegends = FALSE,
              annoWidth = 0.075)
